sloka: जांबूनदमयैः द्वारैः चित्रैः कांचन वेदिकैः ।प्रासादैः हेम वर्णैः च महद्भिः सुसमाकृता ॥४-५८-२१॥
transliteration: jāṁbūnadamayaiḥ dvāraiḥ citraiḥ kāṁcana vedikaiḥ ।prāsādaiḥ hema varṇaiḥ ca mahadbhiḥ susamākṛtā ॥4-58-21॥

translations.english: 'The city has golden gates, golden platforms, huge, goldencoloured, uniformly built mansions surrounded by a tall boundary wall of the colour of sunlight.
